verdicts.why: After Garrett and Ward steal it from the Fridge, HYDRA uses it as a cutting tool to free prisoners and dig for the Gravitonium; it is not back in S.H.I.E.L.D. storage until Coulson retrieves it at Cybertek, so 'In use' fits and 'Secured' does not.

Rogue survives because Kurt offered his own life to Eson in her place; Marvel Database lists his death (cause: sacrificed his life so Eson would spare his sister) in X-Men '97 S2E9. Nothing shows him merely missing.
Strange keeps the watch through the crash and the sale of his possessions; its face is damaged when thugs beat him in a Kathmandu alley as he refuses to give it up, and Mordo hands it back to him.
After the Battle of Vanaheim, Thor lets Hogun stay with his people there; only Volstagg and Fandral return to Asgard and help Thor break out Loki and get Jane away.

In 'Farewell, Cruel World!' (overall episode 86) Radcliffe sends Fitz through the back door, and at Ivanov's base Fitz wakes horrified at what he did (Agnes's and Mace's deaths) before Aida teleports away with him. So the record's last event happens in episode 86, not 87.

Fitz wakes on Ivanov's oil platform in the Baltic Sea, not in Siberia. Siberia (Krasnoyarsk Krai) is where he was taken earlier. The app has no place for the platform, so 'The Framework' alone is right.

value.text: Ben is turned into a rocky giant by the cosmic storm on Doom's station, and his fiancée leaves him. Doom uses Reed's machine to make him human again, but Ben changes back into the Thing to save Reed. He finds love with Alicia Masters and chooses to stay the Thing.

verdicts.why: The record is wrong: Ben is made human, then uses the machine again to become the Thing and save Reed, and only in the epilogue chooses to stay that way because of Alicia. But the machine is Reed's (Victor only powers it), so the proposal's 'Doom's machine' needs fixing.

The sources disagree. Wikipedia says Maya gets a new prosthetic from Skully and later a new look for it, which matches the current text. The Skully fandom page says his first fix is temporary and he later delivers a brand new leg with the Choctaw design, which contradicts the proposal's 'repaired prosthetic'. The current text is not clearly wrong.

Wikipedia says Keller explodes in crystalline growths, then Yo-Yo takes the knife and stops the parasite, which fits 'she must kill it'. Only fandom says the stab is what kills Keller. The sources do not clearly show that the current text is wrong.
Wikipedia says Faber examines Ben's organs and develops the cure, which supports the current text. Marvel Database narrows it to the liver, but that is only a refinement and not a clear error.

Wikipedia's summary of 'Graduation Day' says Cyclops, Wolverine and Jean infiltrate Genosha to tell Magneto that Xavier is dying, which is exactly the current text. Marvel Database tells it differently, but with the sources in conflict the change is not clearly supported.
